summary: Decimal's Signed::abs_sub returned self.abs() when self > other, so 123.abs_sub(122) returned 123 instead of 1. The fix returns self - other while retaining zero when self <= other. The fix updates it_can_calculate_abs_sub in tests/decimal_tests.rs to expect the correct differences. Both reversal regions occur exactly once in their respective revisions. No builds or tests were run.
expected_failure:
assertion `left == right` failed: Input: 123 122
  left: 1
 right: 123
